answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 11209 Country: India Title: As'salamu alaikum va rahmathullahi va barakathou!! This is regarding the proposal I got for my marriage from one of the family. The girl's father is working in a vehicle insurance company. I am not aware whether the money earned by this profession is halal / haram according to Islamic Shariah. If it haram, obviously the children are brought up by the same money. In such a situation is it desirable to marry the girl. Please provide your suggestions. Waiting for your reply in anticipation. Jazakallahu Khairan..... Question: As'salamu alaikum va rahmathullahi va barakathou!! This is regarding the proposal I got for my marriage from one of the family. The girl's father is working in a vehicle insurance company. I am not aware whether the money earned by this profession is halal / haram according to Islamic Shariah. If it haram, obviously the children are brought up by the same money. In such a situation is it desirable to marry the girl. Please provide your suggestions. Waiting for your reply in anticipation. Jazakallahu Khairan..... Answer ID: 11209 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 333/333=M/1430) In the abovementioned case, it is better not to marry in that family, you should prefer religious-minded family. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
